gate.G1: CAGR >= K's, or Calmar >= 1.1 x K's with CAGR >= K -0.5 pp (m = 2, base and calibrated)
gate.G2: pre-tax max DD <= K + 1.0 pp (m = 2, base and calibrated)
gate.G3: 2017+ CAGR >= K -1.0 pp (m = 2, base and calibrated)
gate.G4: CAGR above K in >= 2 of 3 sub-periods P1/P2/P3
gate.G5: block-20 pre-tax bootstrap (seed 20261011, 5000 paths) median of arm - K >= 0.0 pp (base and calibrated)
gate.G7: six OOS windows: median delta CAGR >= 0.0 pp, >= 5/6 with delta CAGR >= -0.5 pp and delta DD <= +3.0 pp, delta DD never above +8.0 pp
gate.G8: pooled OOS bootstrap (M1-M5, 2000 paths each) median >= 0.0 pp
gate.T1: after tax at $100k: arm - K >= 0.0 pp in all three windows
gate.T2: B1-recent (progressive) at $100k: median >= 0.0 pp and share > 0 >= 55%
gate.T3: B2 (flat 20 %) at $100k: median >= 0.0 pp and share > 0 >= 55%
gate.adopt: candidates are adopted only if all of G1-G9 and T1-T3 pass; the selection among survivors is the highest after-tax $100k CAGR on the main window

gates.reason: no arm adopted; every candidate fails at least one pre-registered gate: X1: G4,T1,T2,T3; X2: G7,T1,T2,T3; X3: G4,G7,T1

reference.bootstrap: research/band_h2_combo_v1/RESULTS.json (K), seed 20261011 block 20, 1000 paths: B1-recent 3.8577 %, B2-flat 4.0376 %

params.composition: every arm runs production R2's target series with K's execution layer (H2's December window tested first, then A1u's gain band); X1 postpones an exit to zero whose fill session is in the last DEC_TAIL December sessions, X2 stages a gain-heavy exit to zero down to the early-leg weight (0.5 x vt) for at most X2_CAP_SESSIONS sessions while the early leg's own conditions stand, X3 = X1 + X2 with X1's window first. A suppressed or postponed fill is never re-tried: the target is re-evaluated at every close.

params.signals: production R2 (equity_leveraged_trend_v1 1.2.0): E2 2-of-3 on price closes (SMA200, 252-session price return > 0, close > 126-session max/min midpoint) + early re-entry at 0.5 x vt while E2 off and close > SMA50, vol20 < its 252-session median and close > close 20 sessions ago; exit early below SMA50
params.sizing: vt = min(1, 0.35/vol20) on synthetic QLD*, cap 0.98
